summary:
Independent review of Jinshu 86 (張軌 / 張寔) chronology against the Chinese units only. Supported rows are those whose own act sits under an explicit era phrase (泰始初 for 張錫's grant; 永甯初 for 陰充、陰澹 and the star readers; 永嘉初 for 韓稚、張輔、楊胤; 湣帝即位 / 是時 for 索輔、劉曜's 北地 raid、麹陶、辛攀; 四載於茲 for the Chang'an fall group 劉曜、麹允、胡崧、史淑、王沖 and the 316 van 田齊、陰預、賈騫、吳紹; 張肅's living request at the fall). Conventional year-1 labels follow the Ministry of Education Jin table (泰始 265–274, 永寧 301–302, 永嘉 307–313, 建興 313–316); 泰始元年十二月 is already AD 266, so 265 is a reign-year label, not a converted day. Most other rows fail: career spans for 張軌 and 張寔; invented Han life years and speech-precedent dates; 咸寧/太康 years not in the text; 永興中 read as year 2; Yongjia 2–6 and Jianxing 3 guessed from 俄而/是歲; rulers dated by full reigns; 劉載 and 世祖 dated from later mention; post-fall marches collapsed to 316 while 太興 / 保薨 remain; omitted 卒年六十 and 肅悲憤而卒; 諡曰武公 mixed into living activity; 沒於賊 blocked because 北宮純 later surrenders. Hints copy the same defects. Context units after s0210 were read only as evidence, not as this job's completeness charge.
Independent review of Jin Shu 86 units s0211–s0420 (Zhang Shi’s last campaigns through Zhang Jun’s Shu embassy). Most closed Western years are guessed: the Shanggui cluster is tied to 建興六年 rather than 建武元年; Zhang Mao’s death is 太寧三年 in this chapter and 太寧二年 in the Tongjian; Zhang Jun’s 324–346 span omits 建興四年, age 十八, and competing 太寧 headings; 咸和初 is not 咸和元年 only; ancient citations and heir/embassy notices have no source years. Supported are the 太興三年 murder cluster, 建興初 summons, 歲餘 terrace episode, and the 明年/永昌初 Longxi campaign. Births were not inferred from 年四十八 or 年十八. Later 武公/武王/元王/賜諡/少帝 talk is reception, not life activity.
Owned Chinese in s0421–s0629 supplies only a handful of era clauses—咸和初, 建興中, 太興二年, 咸和八年, 九年, 建興二十一年, 永和元年, 永和二年—plus 在位二十二年卒時年四十, 父卒時年十六, and 卒時年二十七. Almost every owned claim still writes a closed Western year from an external Jin table (Xianhe 5, Xiankang 1/4, Yonghe 3/5/6/8/9, and ancient BC/AD life years). Those endpoints date uncertainty as if it were a known event year, or treat a whole reign as one activity window. Speeches that say 昔西門豹 / 光武 / 樂毅 / 漢高 are later reception, not living chronology; 勒雄既死 and 懷恨九泉 / 穆帝追諡 are retrospective or posthumous and must not feed life dates or active hints. Zhang Jun and Zhang Chonghua are missing death and age claims; Yonghe 9 as Chonghua’s end contradicts 時年二十七 and 在位十一年. A few items are supported: Wang Feng’s thanks-mission after 咸和八年 (AD 333 as a year-label), Ma Ji under 永和元年 (AD 345), the two mothers’ Yonghe-2 honors (AD 346), and undated Yuan Meng. Wang Feng’s hint still fails because 九年復使訪隨豐等 is omitted. Calendar checks confirm the era-label arithmetic where the Chinese actually names the year; they do not authorize inventing years the text never wrote.
Independent review of Jinshu 086 owned units s0630–s0841 (plus s0842 永和十年). Chinese era years that are actually written convert cleanly on the Ministry of Education reign table: Yonghe 10 / Jianxing 42 / Heping 1 = AD 354; Jianxing 43 = AD 355 / Yonghe 11; Xingning 1 = AD 363; 太和初 opens Taihe = AD 366; Taiyuan 1 = AD 376. Those single-year personal events (investitures, the Yonghe 10 campaign, the Jianxing 43 coup cluster, Xingning 1 death/elevation/mission, the Taihe war, the Taiyuan 1 invasion) are supported. 78 of 182 item checks and 26 of 91 person checks pass. The rest fail for four systematic reasons: (1) multi-year reigns and imported emperor/Qin tables used as event windows; (2) exact years invented for undated stretches (Yonghe 9 before 永和十年; Yonghe 11–12 and Shengping 3 after 經年; Shengping 5 on killings that precede 奉升平之號; Xingning 2 on a 太和初 remonstrance; Xianan 1 on the Huan Wen embassy; Yixi 2 on 尋卒); (3) posthumous honors, 故太尉 edicts, 昔-precedents, and the historian’s appraisal dated as living activity; (4) omitted deaths and ages (Yaoling 十歲/害耀靈, Zuo 被殺, Xuanjing 年十四, Tianxi 年六十一, 誅祚二子, multiple executions and 戰死, Guo Zeng/Liu Su 十八九). Tianxi’s death year is not in Jinshu and has competing external readings (406 vs 338–398); do not certify 406. No month/day event required a proleptic Gregorian conversion. No births are stated; none were inferred.

personChecks.reason: Zhi Yu appears only in the appraisal. Yongning 1 / 301 is invented.

personChecks.reason: Appraisal of Zuo’s usurpation. The 353–355 hint is an imported reign, not a date in s0833.

personChecks.reason: Appraisal of Tianxi plus the omitted s0820 death/age. The 363–406 hint repeats unsupported Yixi 2.

尋卒，年六十一。

personChecks.reason: Duke of Zhou is appraisal only. BC 1042 is false precision.

personChecks.reason: Hou Jin is appraisal only. AD 170 is invented.

personChecks.reason: Yu the Great is appraisal only. BC 2100 is a round legendary guess.

findings.problem: 張軌 is given a living AD 301–314 inspectorship, while the Chinese separates 永甯初 appointment, 吾在州八年, 在州十三年, 卒年六十, 諡曰武公, and 維乃父武公. The closed window is activity through office, not uncertainty about one event; inclusive 十三年 from 永甯元年 competes with conventional Jianxing 2 / 314; age 六十 is omitted and must not become a birth year; posthumous 武公 is feeding life dates.
findings.action: Split 張軌 into appointment (永甯初 / conventional 301), later undated or bounded acts, a death claim on 卒年六十 / 軌卒 with competing 313 vs 314 left explicit, an age claim that preserves 六十, and a retrospective reception for 諡曰武公. Clear the 301–314 hints.

findings.problem: Ancestors and speech-precedents (張耳, 齊桓公, 魏尚, 趙充國, 劉陶, 世祖, 袁紹, 鐘儀) are dated to imported life or reign years that the Chinese never writes. Those sentences are later mentions or retrospective citations, not the named person's own dated event.
findings.action: Remove the invented Western intervals and active hints. Keep the mention as retrospective-reference or date the speaker's episode; do not use the citation year as a life date.

findings.problem: Late-Han anecdotes are labeled 漢末 only, yet the rows mint AD 185, 140, or 170. 張軌's later grave rites are his commemoration, not those people's life years.
findings.action: Drop the invented years. Mark the anecdotes unresolved as 漢末, or record 張軌's sacrifice as retrospective reception on its own date.

findings.problem: 張溫 and 皇甫謐 are dated from 張軌's 泰始初 grant; 張華 and 楊珧 are given 咸寧 / 太康 years absent from the Chinese.
findings.action: Leave 父溫 / 皇甫謐 undated or unresolved. Delete the invented Xianning 1 and Taikang 1 conversions for 張華 and 楊珧.

findings.problem: Two marked appearances are fused into one activity span, or 永興中 is read as Yongxing 2 / 305, or 惠帝's grant is expanded to the 290–306 reign.
findings.action: Date each act on its own era phrase. Give 永興中 the 304–306 era bounds or unresolved:true. Date 惠帝遣加 to the 永興 campaign, not the whole reign.

findings.problem: From 永嘉初 through 軌卒 the chapter dates by 俄而, 是歲, 是時, 吾在州八年, and 建興初, never by 永嘉二年–六年 or 建興三年. The rows still assign AD 308–312 and 315. 吾在州八年 after 永甯初 also contradicts Yongjia 4 / 310.
findings.action: Set those episodes unresolved:true with a reason that the year number is unstated, or use one-sided westernBounds only where a prior mark (永嘉初, 湣帝即位, 軌卒) truly bounds the act. Do not invent the missing year. Reset the matching hints.

findings.problem: 張寔 has 永嘉初 and 建興初 in his own biography, yet the rows start at unstated Jianxing 2 / 314 and close at unstated Taixing 3 / 320.
findings.action: Record the 永嘉初 refusal and 建興初 appointment separately; date succession from 軌卒 without forcing 二年; use s0234 建興六年 / 太興 for the later calendar act; delete the 320 endpoint.

findings.problem: Post-fall columns are dated 316 only even when later units show a second march, 陳安叛, 會保薨, or 元帝即位. 司馬睿 is given 317–322 including Yongchang 1, which the chapter never writes.
findings.action: Keep the 316 dispatch/letter on 四載 / 逼遷天子. Leave later Hexi reliefs and 保薨 on their own passages, unresolved if unyeared. Date 琅邪王 in the edict to 316 and the accession from 改年太興; drop 322.

findings.problem: 張肅's death 肅悲憤而卒 is in an owned unit but has no death predicate; the 316 hint looks like office only.
findings.action: Add a death claim on s0199 at the fall; keep the living request separate; do not turn the death into a career span.

findings.problem: 斐等皆沒於賊 is treated as dated 311 activity, while 沒 may mean death or capture and 北宮純 later 降劉聰. The year 永嘉五年 is unstated.
findings.action: Do not record certain deaths from 沒 for this list. Mark the fall episode unresolved or bound after 永嘉初 / the second Luoyang pressure; preserve 北宮純's later surrender as a separate undated 是歲 event.

findings.problem: 湣帝 is given a 313–316 reign window; 曹祛 is re-dated from a later merit notice; 劉載 is dated from the surrender edict's year rather than the earlier usurpation being recalled.
findings.action: Date 湣帝即位 as Jianxing 1 / 313 and the surrender edict as year 4 / 316 on their own rows. Leave 討曹祛 on the earlier undated execution. Classify 劉載僭稱大號 as retrospective-reference, not 316 activity.

findings.problem: These remaining rows use a closed Western year the Chinese does not write for that person's own event, or they copy an unsupported attestation into an active hint.
findings.action: Re-read the cited Chinese; keep only a conventional year label where an era phrase names that act; otherwise unresolved:true. Synchronize or clear the hint.

findings.problem: Shanggui-relief and accession-advice acts are locked to Jianwu 1 / AD 317, but the cluster never says 建武元年; the explicit year is 是歲…建興六年.
findings.action: Replace the closed 317 year with the Chinese anchors 湣帝崩問 and 建興六年, and a 316–318 window or unresolved:true. Resync hints to that cluster, not Jianwu 1.

findings.problem: Emperor Min is given a 316–317 activity span from s0229 death-news.
findings.action: Date the 崩問 as reception of death. Do not extend Min’s life into Jianwu 1. Add a death/reception record; drop the reign-span hint.

findings.problem: Yin Jian’s blocking of Bao is given exact Taixing 3 / 320 without a source year.
findings.action: Use a 建興六年–太興三年 bound (onOrAfter 318, onOrBefore 320) or unresolved:true. Do not print 320–320.

findings.problem: Zhang Gui’s 301–314 life window is taken from later 武公/武王 citations.
findings.action: Keep the retrospective references as reception. Remove the imported Yongning–Jianxing activity dates and hints.

findings.problem: Zhang Shi is given a 314–320 reign without a source start; death and 在位六年 are omitted; 元王/賜諡 are reception.
findings.action: Add a 太興三年 death claim from s0250/s0260. Keep 賜諡 and 元王 as later reception. Drop the unsupported 314 start and the 314–320 hint.

findings.problem: Yuan Di’s 賜諡 is dated as his whole 317–322 reign.
findings.action: Date only the posthumous-name grant, after 太興三年. Do not use the reign as the event window.

findings.problem: Zhang Jun is given Taining 2–Yonghe 2 / 324–346, omitting 建興四年, age 十八, and competing 太寧元年/二年/三年 succession witnesses.
findings.action: Record s0316 and s0317. Preserve 太寧三年卒 vs Tongjian 太寧二年 vs s0335 太寧元年. Drop Yonghe 2. Do not convert 十八 into a birth year. Resync all three Jun IDs.

findings.problem: Zhang Mao’s end is published as Taining 2 / 324, discarding 太寧三年卒, 年四十八, 在位五年, and the Tongjian 太寧二年薨; earlier 建興初/二年 acts are omitted.
findings.action: Add death and age claims from s0303/s0309. Preserve 太寧三年 and Tongjian 太寧二年 as competing ends. Keep 四十八 as sui. Include 建興初/二年 in the person chronology. Do not keep 320–324 only.

findings.problem: Liu Yao’s 322-only window drops s0320’s later investiture of Zhang Jun.
findings.action: Split the Yongchang campaign from the later title; do not use one 322 hint for both.

findings.problem: Fan Yi is dated only 322 despite s0318 at Jun’s succession.
findings.action: Keep the 明年 campaign year and date the succession act from the Mao-death witnesses, not a single 322 hint.

findings.problem: Wu Shao’s 未幾 remonstrance is dated Taining 1 / 323 without that nianhao.
findings.action: Tie it to the 明年 / 永昌初 sequence (soon after 322) or leave unresolved. Do not invent 323.

findings.problem: Jia Mo’s execution is dated Taining 1 although it stands before 永昌初.
findings.action: Place it onOrBefore early Yongchang (AD 322) or unresolved. Remove 323.

findings.problem: Min’s 先是 sending of Shi Shu is locked to Jianxing 4 / 316.
findings.action: Date as during Min’s 建興 reign or unresolved. Do not pick year 4.

findings.problem: Shi Shu and Ma Mo’s appointment of Jun is locked to Taining 2, choosing Tongjian’s year and discarding 太寧三年卒.
findings.action: Preserve 太寧三年 and 太寧二年 as competing succession dates. Do not publish 324 alone.

findings.problem: The Fuhan / Wang Zhi block is dated Taining 3 / 325, but Jin Shu places it before 太寧元年 and the Tongjian puts the mission in 太寧二年.
findings.action: Drop 325. Preserve the chapter order versus Tongjian 太寧二年/三年. Date Liu Yao’s reception as that mission, not a 325–328 reign.

findings.problem: Rhetorical citations of ancient or earlier figures were given modern exact years and treated as living activity.
findings.action: Classify as retrospective-reference/reception with unresolved or no Western year. Clear the invented BC/AD hints. Do not use citation dates as life dates.

findings.problem: Yuan Di’s death-news is labeled Yongchang 1 / AD 322, against s0335–s0336 太寧元年, the 永昌元年閏十一月 death in AD 323, and Tongjian 太寧三年.
findings.action: Date the 崩問 from s0336. Convert 閏十一月己丑 with an explicit Julian vs proleptic-Gregorian note (year 323). Preserve the Tongjian delay. Remove 322–322.

findings.problem: Fan Yi’s era-name speech is headed 太寧元年 in Jin Shu but dated Taining 3.
findings.action: Keep 太寧元年 for s0337 or show it as competing with Tongjian 太寧三年. Do not silently print 325.

findings.problem: Fan Yi’s later talk of 少帝/建興 was turned into Min’s 313–316 life dates.
findings.action: Keep the retrospective speech. Do not write Min’s reign as this record’s activity.

findings.problem: 咸和初 campaigns were collapsed to AD 326–326, hiding Tongjian 咸和二年 and, for Song Ji, earlier s0228 and later s0386.
findings.action: Retain 咸和初; allow 326–327 uncertainty or unresolvedReason. Split Song Ji’s three acts. Do not publish a single 326 year.

findings.problem: Shi Sheng, Suo Xun, Li Bo, and Zhao Zhen were given exact AD 328 with no 咸和三年 in the Chinese.
findings.action: Use a bound after 咸和初 or unresolved:true. Do not invent 328.

findings.problem: Naming Zhang Chonghua heir has no year; Xianhe 5 / 330 was invented.
findings.action: Set unresolved:true with a reason. Clear the 330 hint. Do not invent a birth.

findings.problem: The Shu embassy is an undated 先是 flashback, yet it is dated 326 or, for Li Xiong, 326–334.
findings.action: Keep 先是 and the separate 咸和初 notice. Drop the closed 326 year and Li Xiong’s imported 334 death end.

findings.problem: Xin Tao, Zhang Xuan, and Dong Guang share s0228 with dated colleagues but were left undated with empty hints.
findings.action: Give them the same 湣帝崩問 / 建興六年 cluster context as the rest of the column. Do not invent Jianwu 1.

findings.problem: Most personal events in s0422–s0628 are narrated without a new era year after 咸和初, 太興二年, 咸和八年/九年, 永和元年, and 永和二年. The extraction still assigns closed Xianhe 5, Xiankang 1/4/6, Yonghe 3/5/6/8, and similar Western years from an external Jin table.
findings.action: For each owned claim, keep the Chinese event and strip invented sourceDate/westernInterval pairs. Where the narrative only follows an earlier year-header, either leave the date unresolved with a substantive reason or use a one-sided westernBounds tied to the last explicit header (onOrAfter that conventional year). Synchronize hints to the repaired personal events only.

findings.problem: s0449 says 咸和初, not 咸和元年–三年. Liu Yao’s death by Shi Le is undated. Several Liu Yao/Han Pu/Xin Yan evidence lists cite palace-colour units s0445/s0447 (西曰政刑白殿; 其傍皆有直省內官寺署) that do not name those men.
findings.action: Retarget evidence to s0449–s0452. Preserve 咸和初 as the source date; convert only the 咸和 label (Cheng of Jin, first year AD 326) without closing a 326–328 reign or rewriting 初 as exact Xianhe 1. Remove the invented Xianhe-3 end.

findings.problem: Speeches cite 西門豹, 解扁, 文侯, 周穆王, 光武/世祖, 樂毅, 騎劫, 韓信, 穰苴, 呂蒙, 魏延, 耿弇, 黃權, 方邵, 慕容皝, 漢高, and 王陵. Those are later references, not dated life events of the named persons. The extraction assigned external life/reign years and copied them into active hints.
findings.action: Reclassify each as retrospective-reference or receptionType: retrospective on the citation. Keep the citation as its own event with the host speech’s date context if any. Clear life-date hints. Do not infer death from retrospective use.

findings.problem: s0493 駿在位二十二年卒，時年四十 and 穆帝追諡, s0498 父卒時年十六, and s0629 將受詔未及而卒時年二十七 are omitted as death/age/reception. Living-rule claims instead use Taining 2–Yonghe 2 or Yonghe 1/2–Yonghe 9. Yonghe 9 is not in the Chinese; 在位十一年 (s0630) and the two ages conflict with a 353 end. s0623 懷恨九泉 and later 文王/明王 honors are posthumous reception used as life dates.
findings.action: Add death and age claims for Zhang Jun (age 40; 22 years in power) and Zhang Chonghua (age 16 at father’s death; died at 27) without converting ages into birth years. Keep 穆帝追諡 and 九泉/追崇 as reception events dated from their own passages. Rebuild living windows only from 永和元年 appointment, 永和二年 accession, and unresolved or bounded death after the last living acts. Drop Yonghe 9 and unsourced Taining 2.

findings.problem: Geng Fang’s sourced chain is 建興中 / 太興二年 / 七年 / 咸和八年 / 九年. The claim starts at Taixing 2 and ends at Xianhe 8. Jia Ling’s sending is dated with the arrival year. Wang Feng’s 333-only hint drops 九年復使訪隨豐等.
findings.action: Split Geng Fang into separate dated events for 建興中, 太興二年 (AD 319), the seven-year stay, 咸和八年 arrival (AD 333), and 九年. Date Jia Ling’s dispatch as pre-arrival and the arrival as Xianhe 8. Extend Wang Feng’s active hint to include the year-9 mission or record that mission as its own event.

findings.problem: Shi Le and Li Xiong are dated from undated frontier diplomacy or from 勒雄既死 in a later memorial. Shi Hu is given Xianhe 9–Yonghe 5 or Yonghe 3–5 including undated 季龍自斃. Those are reign windows and retrospective death notices, not sourced living endpoints.
findings.action: Keep each named act (殺劉曜, 分境, 稱臣, 既死, 自斃) as its own event. Mark years unresolved unless a nearby explicit era year governs that sentence. Do not use 既死/自斃 as living active hints or as exact Western death years.

findings.problem: Evidence IDs are misaligned with the Chinese: Liu Yao/Han Pu/Xin Yan cite palace units s0445/s0447; Yang Xuan cites s0431 號曰積賢君 instead of s0434 楊宣率眾越流沙.
findings.action: Replace evidence with the units that actually name the person (s0449–s0452; s0434). Do not trust English translations where they drift from the Chinese.

findings.problem: Emperor Mu’s 賜諡 and Xiaowu’s 賜諡 are undated later honors; the extraction dated each emperor’s entire reign as if that were the event.
findings.action: Date each 賜諡 as a reception/honor with unresolved year or a bound inside that emperor’s reign. Remove the reign-span attestation and the matching active hints.

findings.problem: Zhang Gui, Zhang Shi, Zhang Mao and Zhang Jun appear in these units only as later praise, 追崇 king-titles, 故太尉, kinship tags, or historian’s appraisal. Their reign years were imported as living activity.
findings.action: Keep the reception/identification. Move Gui/Shi/Mao honors to retrospective reception dated to Heping 1 / Yonghe 10 (s0655) or to the post-淮肥 edict (s0808). Do not attach Yonghe 2 to s0749. Clear the 301–314 / 314–320 / 320–324 / 346 hints.

findings.problem: Yaoling’s succession/murder, Lady Ma’s deposition, Zuo’s first seizure, and Zhao Chang/Wei Ji’s early pact stand before 永和十年, yet were given an exact Yonghe 9 / AD 353 year. Zuo was also given a 353–355 reign window. p303 dates a later kinship heading as if Yaoling were still alive.
findings.action: Use onOrBefore Yonghe 10 / AD 354 (s0842) or unresolved:true. Do not invent AD 353. Add Yaoling’s age 十歲 and death 害耀靈. Treat s0697 as retrospective. Split Zuo’s undated seizure from the Yonghe 10 imperial claim.

findings.problem: Reign-length or house-duration notices (篡立三年, 在位九年, 即位十三年, 七十六年) and imported ruler tables were turned into activity windows. Tianxi’s end ‘Yixi 2’ / 406 is not in Jinshu and conflicts with a 338–398 reading. Fu Jian’s 357–385 reign is not narrated here.
findings.action: Split accession and death. Keep 三年/九年/十三年 as reign length, not Gregorian spans. For Tianxi’s death use 尋卒，年六十一 after 桓玄時 with unresolved year or competing 406/398 bounds; do not certify 406. Fu Jian: date only 太和初, 太元元年, and 淮肥.

findings.problem: After 建興四十三年 the narrative (Li Yan, Wei Shen 經年, Tian Xuan/Ma Ji, Quan’s fall, Hun’s regency) has no year labels. The extraction invented Yonghe 11, Yonghe 12, and Shengping 3 and extended Hun to Shengping 5 after 混卒.
findings.action: Mark those stretches unresolved, or bound them after Jianxing 43 / AD 355 and before Jianxing 49 / Shengping (s0740). Honor 經年. Add Hun’s death and the executions of Tian Xuan, Ma Ji 馬基, and Quan’s destruction. Delete Shengping 3.

findings.problem: The Yong–Tianxi palace struggle and the later 初 adoption flashback were all labelled Shengping 5, a year that appears only when s0740 奉升平之號 after Yong is already dead. Ages 十八九 were omitted.
findings.action: Date the era change at s0740 as Jianxing 49 / Shengping / AD 361. Leave the preceding killings and the 初 adoption unresolved or onOrBefore that change. Add Song Cheng’s killing, Yong’s suicide, and Guo Zeng/Liu Su’s ages without converting them to birth years.

findings.problem: Suo Shang’s remonstrance sits after 太和初, not in Xingning 2 / AD 364.
findings.action: Move the date into the 太和初 block (conventional AD 366 opening) or leave unresolved relative to s0753. Delete the Xingning 2 hint.

findings.problem: The Huan Wen alliance embassy (s0778–s0785) has no Xianan 1.
findings.action: Set unresolved:true on the embassy, or bound it after 時苻堅強盛 and before 太元元年. Delete AD 371 hints.

findings.problem: Sun Quan, Meng Ming, Yu, the Duke of Zhou, Zhi Yu and Hou Jin are later citations or historian’s appraisal. Exact years (222–252, 627 BC, 2100 BC, 1042 BC, 301, 170) are not in the Chinese.
findings.action: Classify as retrospective-reference or receptionType:retrospective. Leave dates unresolved. Do not assign living-activity hints. Do not infer death from retrospective.

findings.problem: s0805 dates Fu Rong by 淮肥, not Taiyuan 8. Zizhi Tongjian vol. 105 places that battle in Taiyuan 8 / AD 383, but the claim’s sourceDate pretends Jinshu wrote the era year.
findings.action: Set sourceDate to 淮肥/淝水 and convert with the Tongjian witness. Do not keep ‘Taiyuan 8’ as if it were a Jinshu label.

findings.problem: 道子嘗問 is one undated remark; 隆安中 is an era-middle label; 桓玄時 is a period label. These were expanded into Daozi 385–402, Yuanxian 398–402, and Huan Xuan 402–404.
findings.action: Keep 隆安中 as during Long’an (AD 397–401) without inventing Long’an 2 or Yuanxing 1. Leave 嘗問 and 桓玄時 unresolved or one-sided after Tianxi’s return. Delete career-span hints.

findings.problem: Owned Chinese states deaths, killings, or ages that were never extracted as death/age claims (Yaoling 十歲/害耀靈; Zuo 被殺; Taihe/Tingjian 誅祚二子; Ding Qi 斬; Lady Ma 卒; Xuanjing 年十四; Wang Luan/Suo Fu; Hun 卒; Tian Xuan/Ma Ji 斬; Cheng/Yong; Qin 伏法; Tianxi 年六十一; Chang Ju/Xi Le/Zhao Chongzhe/Shi Jing 戰死).
findings.action: Add death (and age where written) on the existing person IDs and source units. Preserve 歲 as age. Do not compute birth years. Keep later reception (私諡, 追贈) as separate events.

findings.problem: Zhang Dahuai is named heir after 太和初 and later deposed (廢大懷) without a year; the hint keeps only 366.
findings.action: Keep the heir appointment in the 太和初 block. Add the undated deposition as a later event with unresolved date. Do not invent a death.
